title: Open-local perfect Hom continuity condition
statement: Let $I$ be a preordered set, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, $c$ a cocone, $i\in I$, and $s:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Assume the scheme derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category] exist. For an open $W\subseteq X$, define $\mathcal C(W)$ as follows. For every scheme $Y$, every open immersion $t:Y\to X$ with open image exactly $W$, and every morphism $s_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ equal to $s\circ t$, suppose $s_Y$ is locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated and the derived categories on the localized open sites of $Y$ exist. For all perfect $P,Q\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-perfect-complex], put $Y_j=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ and $Y_\infty=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(c.pt)$, with $P_j,Q_j,P_\infty,Q_\infty$ their derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Write $T_{j,k}$ and $T_{j,\infty}$ for the canonical Hom transports [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. Require both: (a) for every $j_0\ge i$ and $\varphi:P_\infty\to Q_\infty$, there exist $j\ge j_0$ and $a:P_j\to Q_j$ with $T_{j,\infty}(a)=\varphi$; (b) for $j\ge i$ and $a,b:P_j\to Q_j$ with $T_{j,\infty}(a)=T_{j,\infty}(b)$, there exists $k\ge j$ such that $T_{j,l}(a)=T_{j,l}(b)$ for every $l\ge k$.
